newsitem.title: USA: Smurfit hopeful for containerboard prices.
newsitem.headline: Smurfit hopeful for containerboard prices.

text.p: Paper and packaging manufacturer Jefferson Smurfit Group Plc said on Tuesday it was more optimist about the outlook for containerboard prices in 1997 than it had been a month ago based on an improved capacity outlook.

"There is nothing on the demand or the inventory side to prevent containerboard price increases," Ray Curran, Jefferson Smurfit Group finance director of the Ireland-based company told Reuters in an interview in New York.
Curran said demand for containerboard was excellent, inventory was low and the capacity situation looked better.
"New capacity additions absent, things look pretty good for containerboard medium-term," Curran said.
Jefferson Smurfit Group owns a 46.5 percent stake in U.S.-based Jefferson Smurfit Corp.
